children: (TheNewswire)
Edmonton—November 23, 2026 – TheNewswire - Golden Rapture Mining

is pleased to announce it has closed the first tranche of its $700,000 non-brokered private placement, originally announced on October 30, 2026. The first tranche of the financing closed on November 23, 2026, for gross proceeds of $130,890.00.
The closing of the first tranche consists of the following issuance of non-flow-through (NFT) units and flow-through (FT) units, with pricing and breakdown as follows:
1,663,000 FT units at $0.03 with a 36-month full warrant exercisable at $0.05 per whole warrant, for gross proceeds of $49,890; and
3,240,000 NFT units at $0.025 with a 36-month full warrant exercisable at $0.05 per whole warrant, for gross proceeds of $81,000.
Ventum Financial will receive a cash finder's fee of $2,500 and 100,000 finders' fee warrants at an exercise of $0.05 for a period of 36 months following the issuance.

Non-flow-through gross proceeds are expected to be used for corporate General & Administrative costs. Flow-through funds are expected to be used for eligible exploration expenses at Golden Rapture's NW Ontario projects.
President Richard Rivet on the raise:
"We want to thank our shareholders for their interest and support. We look forward to attempting to secure the last tranche of this financing in these difficult market conditions."

The Common Shares, Warrants and Finder’s Warrants are subject to a statutory hold period expiring on the date that is four months and one day upon issuance. The Offering is subject to final CSE Exchange acceptance.
About Golden Rapture Mining

Golden Rapture Mining Corporation is a Canadian exploration-stage company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of high-potential mineral properties in Ontario. The Company's portfolio of properties includes the Phillips Township, Swell Bay, Bully Boy, South of Goliath, Northern Queen and the Hutchison Mine project.
